identity.title: [v0.91.8][google-workspace][automation] Make ADL Drive context mirror work end to end

values.goal: Run the ADL context mirror against Google Drive with recursive, content-verified, least-privilege behavior.
values.required_outcome: Execute mode uses the native Drive transport, mirrors the declared repository surfaces recursively, and succeeds only after exact remote-content readback.
authority_boundary: Issue #5587 owns production Drive mirror behavior and its focused proof
Remote deletion and broader Workspace access are excluded
